text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After signing on as Hokko<n>Tarumae's trainer, I
spend my days<n>helping her prepare for the
upcoming<n>scrimmage.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Controlled bursts of speed, start dash<n>strategies,
and stamina training... Yep,<n>I could definitely stand to
improve on<n>those.
choice_data_list:
Then let's work on 'em and crush your
scrimmage!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Then, a few days later...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
...And they're off! Hokko Tarumae is<n>starting strong
along the inner rail!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Panting...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(All right, I've got a good position. It's<n>going just
like we practiced... so right<n>now, I've just got to
keep it up!)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: (And then I'll win. I'll win this, andbecome someone that Tomakomai...is proud of!)

text_block_list.name: Young Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
What? You're closing down too? But<n>I love your
shellfish special...

text_block_list.name: Tomakomai Restaurant Owner
text_block_list.text:
I know. It's a shame to do this to my<n>regulars like
you, but we just<n>haven't been gett'n enough
cust'mers in. It's about time I cut my<n>losses.

text_block_list.name: Young Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
But... W-wait! If I got more customers<n>to visit, you
wouldn't have to close,<n>right?!

text_block_list.name: Young Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'm Hokko Tarumae! Have you folks<n>ever tried
Tomakomai's<n>jaw-dropp'n shellfish dishes?

text_block_list.name: Young Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Well guess what? I got special<n>permission to chat
with you about my<n>favorite food after the concert! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tomakomai Restaurant Owner
text_block_list.text:
My goodness... You really did bring in<n>a whole flood
of cust'mers. Thank<n>you so much, Tarumae.

text_block_list.name: Young Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Hehe, glad to have helped! Crisis<n>averted, right?

text_block_list.name: Young Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
It's been a while since I've gotten<n>the shellfish
special. I can't wait!<n>...Huh? This isn't...

text_block_list.name: Young Tarumae
text_block_list.text: The restaurant... is gone...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(Revitalizing a small town isn't easy.<n>Generating
one-off hype isn't<n>enough—the stream of people
will<n>just vanish like the tide.)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: (It takes planning and effort to sustainlong-term tourism, and a lot ofenthusiasm. And then, even if I dowell, there's no guarantee that it'll beenough to keep businesses afloat.)

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae is hovering around<n>third and fourth.
The lead's only got<n>200 meters to go, and is
surging<n>ahead by two—three lengths!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(But still... Still... I don't want to give<n>up without a
fight!)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(Because Tomakomai is... Tomakomai<n>is my light,
so...)

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae overtakes second,<n>and she's
gunning for first!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I'LL SHOW THEM ALL!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Hokko Tarumae snatches the lead!<n>And she wins it!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Panting... ...Ah!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I-I'm Hokko Tarumae, from<n>Tomakomai City!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
It's a beautiful, cherished place, so<n>please! Please
visit Tomakomai!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what'd she say the name was?
Toma...komai? Have you heard of it? I<n>wonder
where it is.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I think I miiight've heard the name<n>before? If I'm
not mistaken, it's a<n>city up in Hokkaido
somewhere.<n>Lemme search it real quick.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The next day, Hokko Tarumae visits<n>me in my
office.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry! Thinking back, I more or<n>less forced
you into the training<n>contract...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
It's just, you really opened my eyes,<n>and um, it's
all thanks to you that I<n>figured out what I want to do
going<n>forward.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
With your guidance, I was able to<n>truly focus on
winning races. And so,<n>um...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I just kinda feel like my local idol<n>activities will go
better with you<n>helping... and you even like haskap
berries, so...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Um, I mean, so like basically... T-to<n>get to the
point of why I'm here...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I guess this is pretty late coming, but...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Please accept my business card. I,<n>Hokko Tarumae,
hope to continue<n>working with you in future.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I scramble up to accept the card<n>properly, and she
places it in my<n>hands. The background is a
majestic<n>shot of a volcano—Tomakomai's<n>Mount
Tarumae.
